d: Football likes to say it has fixed racism. Then a 16-year-old gets allegedly abused on the pitch in a youth qualifier, and you realise that it hasn't fixed anything. It has just moved the problem down to younger players. That's what happened to Dallalmuon Gangte and Indian football. India's U-17 captain. He wasn't supposed to be dealing with this. He was supposed to be worrying about the Indian Under-17 team. Instead, he was at the centre of an alleged racist gesture in the middle of India v Palestine. A qualifier for the AFC U-17 Asian Cup. A game for kids. Rupha Ramani critically looks…
